Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to play in the park. One day, she saw a big jug on the ground. 

Lily's mom asked her to clean it up because it looked heavy and mysterious. Lily didn't want her mom to worry, so she suggested that they clean it up together. 

As they were cleaning the day, Lily saw a squirrel running around it. She asked her mom if she could have one. Her mom said yes, so they cleaned up the jug and made it shiny again. 

Lily was so happy that she cleaned the jug
